description: This file implements environment variable management functions for different operating systems, including getting, setting, unsetting environment variables, and manipulating environment blocks. It defines the Environment class and its implementation, along with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: EnvironmentImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Environment interface, providing platform-specific methods for environment variable access and modification.

methods.name: GetVar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, trying alternate case if not found initially.

methods.name: SetVar
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: ParseEnvLine
methods.description: Parses a line from an environment block into key-value components.
